defender_rwe_intake.definition: A defender-RWE documents a real-world instance of the DEFENSE side: either a defender-archetype deployment of the objection (archetype_signal_observed=defender) or a refutation-of-deployment instance (instance_polarity=refutation-of-deployment, 23 already exist; deploys-for, 10 exist).
criteria: 1. Primary source: source_url + archive_url + accessed_date all present (v1.7 attestation - no paywalled-memory or recalled-from-training sourcing)
2. Verbatim short_quote_under_15_words + paraphrased_summary, quote checkable against the archive copy
3. Explicit attached_objections[] with fit_to_trigger_phrases + attachment_rationale at the evidential bar of existing instances
4. archetype_signal_observed=defender requires archetype_signal_rationale grounded in the source text, not vibes
5. Defamation posture per defamation_posture_note_v1_6 for named individuals

6. NO-FORCE RULE (handout-locked): where the defender stance has no real-world instance, the slot stays empty - absence recorded as absence; synthesizing or stretching an instance to fill coverage is the forbidden padding
7. Every intake must pass v3prime_validator_v1_7.py attestation rules before fold
defender_rwe_intake.sourcing_bar: Same bar as the existing 136 - the 15 defender-signal + 23 refutation-polarity instances are the working precedent set; mirror their field discipline.
